# Test record template

Copy this file for a new test. Unfilled fields are not results.

| Field | Entry |
| --- | --- |
| Test ID / related requirement | |
| Date / author / reviewer | |
| Hardware and software configuration | |
| Related issue / commit | |
| Test setting and conditions | |
| Instrument / calibration reference | |
| Expected result / acceptance rule | |
| Evidence files | |
| Measured result and units | |
| Outcome: pass / fail / incomplete | |
| Limitations and next action | |

## Procedure

Document the actual steps and any deviations.

## Observations

Include sample size, failures, and interventions.

## Interpretation

State what the result supports, what it does not establish, and whether another test is required.
